selection_rule: Build several genuinely different combinations from available mechanisms; no fixed winner and no mandatory monolithic integration. Record which were built, not merely named.

compositions.title: Sequence effects that answer questions
compositions.path: Exact sequence -> local predicates -> finite/affine effect hierarchy -> incoming-state query -> source refinement. Keep both finite and floating answers identifiable.

compositions.title: Residual-backed latent context
compositions.path: Adaptive boundaries -> coarse/detail split -> higher-layer subscription -> compact requested objects -> dense feature mixing -> optional residual decode.

compositions.title: One genome, many variants
compositions.path: Exact repeat DAG -> variant delta worlds -> dependency invalidation -> guarded query memo. Compare each world against separate execution on a tiny fixture.

compositions.title: Real nonlocal context
compositions.path: Input-derived region keys -> whole-input directory -> event relation tiles -> sparse contextual update wave. No oracle input packet.

compositions.title: Learning compiles away
compositions.path: Small floating teacher -> discrete typed circuit -> state-conditioned predicate bank -> approximate candidate nomination -> exact or richer verification.

compositions.title: Ports and factorized hypotheses
compositions.path: Condensed regional response ports -> multi-role factor join -> counterfactual packet evaluation. Separate synthetic algebra from biological interpretation.

compositions.title: Dense possible states, sparse execution
compositions.path: Evaluate a bounded state vocabulary through tensor tiles -> distill a discrete transition table -> execute the hardened regional effect through shuffles.

compositions.title: Hierarchy repairs its own blind spots
compositions.path: Alternative seams/parse forest -> query-specific summary portfolio -> detected representation collision -> targeted split/residual/predicate addition.

compositions.title: Precision follows a budget
compositions.path: Early precision planes -> uncertainty/priority buckets -> opcode cohorts -> extra planes only for unresolved work, with starvation debt visible.

compositions.title: Cheap role sketches, precise relations
compositions.path: Role-bound binary sketches -> multi-probe nomination -> full posting lookup -> small learned relation tile with exact source-pair provenance.
